sub_site: serum (Takayasu arteritis, giant cell arteritis, healthy donors)

evidence.quote: A total of 13 patients with TAK (20 blood samples), 9 patients with GCA (11 blood samples) and 15 HD patients were analysed.
The V3-V4 hypervariable regions of the 16S rDNA were amplified and quantified by qPCR, and sequenced with MiSeq technology (Vaiomer, Labège, France).

controls.types: reagent/negative controls (in vitro and in silico)

evidence.quote: Numerous controls were performed both in vitro and in silico to ensure the absence of artefacts
the abundance of 16S ribosomal RNA genes is 1000-fold lower in negative controls compared with blood samples. The blood samples have also higher genus richness and a different composition
OTUs with a prevalence < 5% were removed from the analysis
The concentration of 16S rRNA gene copies normalized to 1 mL of serum in each sample was determined by real-time qPCR

notes: Vaiomer blood 16S pipeline. Negative controls only described in Discussion (lower 16S copies, different composition) - counted as sequenced but no control-based removal. Only LEfSe-differential genera named; Clostridium from BLAST of unidentified Clostridiaceae OTU (C. saudiense). Cloacibacterium misspelt 'Coacibacterium' in Results. 'Pseudarcella hirudinis' BLAST hit not recorded. n = 46 serum samples (41 subjects).
